intent: Add an independently invokable Maven hello-world goal

name: HelloMojo
role: Implements the direct-invocation hello goal and writes the fixed greeting through Maven's standard logger.
conditions: No lifecycle phase, parameters, index access, or selection side effects.

title: keep the hello-world greeting as an independent Maven goal
why: A dedicated Mojo preserves the selection pipeline's existing contract while Maven generates a discoverable direct-invocation goal from the annotation.
alternative: Add a hello branch to SelectMojo — rejected: it couples a smoke-test greeting to selection configuration and behavior.
